title: Issue with macOS (v26) and Godot (4.7.1) deadlocking when compiling CanvasShaderRD on M4/5 silicon
body:
### Tested versions

- Issue occurs on 4.7.1.stable.mono.official using both native Metal and--rendering-driver vulkan (moltenVK 1.4.1).

- 4.6.3 Metal on Mac does not hang compiling the shaders, and the title screen remains functions and animated, though the 4.7.1 project isn’t fully playable on 4.6.3.
- Also runs 4.7.1 using --rendering-method gl_compatbility --rendering-driver opengl3. 
- Zero issues with Windows builds.

Downloaded Godot versions:
4.7.1 a13da4feb
4.6.3 7d41c59c4

Macs:
- Both on macOS 26.6.2 (25G83)
- MacBook Pro, M5, AGXMetalG17G
- Mac mini, M4, AGXMetalG16G_B0





### System information

macOS 26.6.2, MacBook Pro M5 and Mac mini M4, Metal and Vulcan.

### Issue description

We came across an interesting issue when trying to draw canvas/compute shaders to the screen when using Metal on macOS 26 + Godot 4.7.1. Once the shaders are read and then the pipeline is being built, the entire game deadlocks and requires a force close.

Log examples...

Mac mini M4:
[godot_vulkan_hang_sample_2026-08-24_tsuki_m4.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32183312/godot_vulkan_hang_sample_2026-08-24_tsuki_m4.txt)
[godot_metal_hang_sample_2026-08-24_tsuki_m4.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32183314/godot_metal_hang_sample_2026-08-24_tsuki_m4.txt)
MacBook Pro M5:
[godot_metal_hang_sample_2026-08-24.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32183313/godot_metal_hang_sample_2026-08-24.txt)




### Steps to reproduce

Steps:
- Starting Godot using "--path ." or from within Godot itself, same issue.
- Clean booting without using a save file.
- Splash screen shows as normal but is not animated.
- Startup fails during compile.
- CPU drops to 0% on Godot after ~15 seconds
- Godot needs to be force-quit

- Log shows the last hit as... 
Shader cache miss for CanvasShaderRD/1ac5f6c8d534ebab572b3f886e38134784245fbd5fa01c7cbb6cc452e5400080/<variant>
and then compute GLSL, then nothing else gets appended.
- Threasd stuck sample... com.apple.MTLCompilerConnectionQueue
- stack...
newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor >
createFragmentProgramVariant >
compileFunction_Impl >
MTLCompilerSchdulr::buildRequest
- Main thread...
std::condition_variable::wait

Other notes:

- samples have no .NET frames.
- I checked these and they're not the same:
#106757 (slow first compile, eventually finishes)
#119436 (runtime fence timeout)
#120566 (Metal 2D crash)... Vulkan is working here, we're getting the hardlock trying it.

Engine log:
Metal 4.0 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: Apple - Apple M4 (Apple9)... [M5 on the MacBook Pro]


Tried these in testing:
- Tested an empty Forward+ ColorRect on 4.7.1 Metal and it boots normally.
- Loading of the shaders but not drawing them boots, preload_done is fine, the hang occurs when Metal goes to actually build the GPU pipeline for the shader, then the hardlock.
- We load a lot of 2D canvas shaders on an "LED Lattice" (think a virtual TV screen), plus RenderingDevice compute .glsl, and many CanvasShaderRD variants drawn.

OpenGL is our fallback, but we'd like to use Metal to be more performant on Macs.



### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[CanvasShaderRD_Metal_Hang_MRP.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32185216/CanvasShaderRD_Metal_Hang_MRP.zip)
Apologies, accidently let an extra folder in the zip file... it's late, that's my lame excuse.


If you need more in the MRP, please let me know.
